changelog:
Initial release of proof-of-contribution skill.

- Guides developers to set up automatic Bitcoin payments for open source contributions via GitHub Actions.
- Supports Lightning payments for every download and install—no middleman, no KYC.
- Provides setup instructions for integrating the action into GitHub workflows.
- Includes example usage for retrieving Bitcoin stats.
- Tags and categories for discoverability in finance/crypto and open source payment ecosystems.
summary: The GitHub Action that pays open source developers in Bitcoin. Every download = sats. Every install = Lightning payment. No middleman. No KYC. Just code and...
